3. **Subcategories** - Further divide each Category into more specific outcomes of technical and management activities [NIST.CSWP.29 p.10]

The CSF Core components form "a hierarchy of Functions, Categories, and Subcategories that detail each outcome" [NIST.CSWP.29 p.6]. The order and size of these elements does not imply their sequence or importance [NIST.CSWP.29 p.7].
